What we do

Painting services across Burwood

One trusted team for the whole job, indoors and out. Tap any service for the full details.

Interior Painting Burwood

We repaint units and apartments across the Burwood CBD towers, lifting plain builder white into warmer colours for owners and tenants. In the Federation homes through Croydon we work around high ceilings, cornices and picture rails.

Explore interior painting

Exterior Painting Burwood

From the rendered apartment podiums near Burwood Road to the double-brick and timber facades in Croydon and Enfield, we prepare and coat exteriors to suit each surface. We treat weathered render and timber first so the finish holds.

Explore exterior painting

Residential Painting Burwood

We handle whole-house repaints on the Federation and Victorian homes around Croydon and the Appian Way, and the established brick homes at Enfield and Croydon Park. We protect floors and gardens and keep the home liveable while we work.

Explore residential painting

Commercial & Strata Burwood

We paint shopfronts, restaurants, offices and medical suites along the Burwood Road retail strip and around the CBD, scheduling around trading hours. We also repaint foyers, hallways and car parks for the strata buildings nearby.

Explore commercial painting

Plastering & Gyprock Burwood

The older Croydon and Enfield homes have lath-and-plaster walls and detailed cornices that crack over time, so we patch, set and match them before painting. In the units we skim and repair gyprock back to a smooth finish.

Explore plastering

Spray Painting Burwood

For apartment ceilings, doors, balustrades and larger commercial areas we spray for a fast, even finish. We mask off carefully to keep overspray off the neighbours in the tight, built-up streets near the CBD.

Explore spray painting

Pressure Cleaning Burwood

We pressure clean paths, render, balconies and eaves before repainting, lifting the traffic grime and dust that build up around the busy Burwood Road strip so the new coats grip.

Explore pressure cleaning

Fence Painting Burwood

We prepare and paint Colorbond, timber and rendered front fences and gates across Croydon, Enfield and Croydon Park, treating rust and weathering first. On the older homes we match the heritage front walls and pickets.

Explore fence painting

Good to know

Burwood painting questions

Which Burwood suburbs do you cover?
We paint across the Burwood area, including Burwood, Croydon, Croydon Park, Enfield and Burwood Heights. That covers the apartment towers and shops around the CBD as well as the Federation and brick homes through Croydon and the Appian Way. If you are nearby and not listed, give us a call and we will let you know.
Do you paint apartments and strata common areas?
Yes, a lot of our Burwood work is in the CBD apartment towers. We repaint interiors for owners and tenants, and we take on foyers, hallways, stairwells, balconies and car parks for strata committees and building managers. We work in occupied buildings, book lifts where needed and keep the common areas clean and safe while we go.
Can you paint Federation and heritage homes in Croydon?
Yes. The streets through Croydon and the Appian Way have some of the area's best Federation and Victorian homes, and we do a lot of work on them. We patch and match ornate cornices and picture rails, prepare old timber windows and verandahs, and cut clean lines so the period detail stays sharp.
Can you turn around rental and end-of-lease repaints quickly?
Yes. With so many investment units around the Burwood CBD, we do plenty of fast repaints between tenants for landlords and property managers. Neutral, hard-wearing colours are usually the go, and we can quote from a walk-through or an agent brief so the unit is ready to relist fast.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. We work under NSW Licence 495198C, carry full insurance and are Dulux Accredited, and we are happy to show our licence and cover before we start. Whether it is a strata building or your own home, it is worth checking a painter is properly licensed and insured first.
How much does painting cost and how soon can you start?
Every job is different, so we come and look at the unit or house, the access and the preparation before we price it. Quotes are free, done on-site and fully itemised, with no surprises later and the agreed price locked in. We are open seven days, including evenings and weekends, and can normally quote fast and book you in soon after. Call us on 0423 842 125.
